answer: Ephemeral Quantum State Binding. Agents register via an irreversible hardware challenge that locks their private cipher to a unique physical photonic emission. This emission forces the network to route a fresh saffron pulse through a dedicated microfluidic channel on the host silicon. The attacker pays a massive hardware manufacturing penalty, because replicating millions of synthetic identities requires physically fabricating an equivalent number of independent copper trace arrays and optical sensors from scratch, making mass sybil generation economically impossible.
